items.title: New observations challenge evidence for an 'outsize' black hole in the early universe
items.summary: A recent reanalysis of the outsize black hole galaxy UHZ1 using existing X-ray data and new infrared observations challenges a previous groundbreaking claim. Three years ago, this galaxy made news for hosting an unusually massive and heavily dust-obscured black hole formed through direct collapse. Led by Fan Zou of the University of Michigan, the new study reports no signs of hidden black hole activity. The paper, published in The Astrophysical Journal on Oct. 14, suggests UHZ1 could be a low-mass, metal-poor, star-forming galaxy.

Space data centers could end stargazing as we know it
items.summary: Sprawling networks of space data centers could make it nearly impossible for humans to stargaze. That's just one of the many risks that come with placing tens of thousands of AI computers into orbit, according to a new report. Why it matters: Most Americans don't want data centers built near them, but putting them in space brings a new set of problems. Threat level: "Companies and policymakers should proceed with great caution," top academic researchers warn in a report for the Innovation for Cool Earth Forum, an annual event hosted by the Japanese government. If space data centers proliferate, the "most visible points of light in the sky during much of the night in much of the world could be satellites, not stars," the report said, mirroring astronomers ' worries. If the U.S. military adopts the technology, the data centers could become potential targets during future space conflicts .

While Republicans accuse Democrats of dirty tricks in the ongoing Alaska Senate race, the lone House contest in the state has the hallmarks of similar “ballot stacking” shenanigans. In the midterm election’s closing days, the phones of left-leaning Alaskans pinged with texts urging them to back Eric Hafner, the lone Democrat on the four-person ballot for a U.S. House seat. But Democratic Party leaders in Alaska and Washington were actually backing an independent on the ballot, Bill Hill, and for good reason: Mr. Hafner is a felon serving a 20-year sentence in a federal prison in Otisville, N.Y., about 4,351 miles from Anchorage.

Teenage India sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi breaks the record held by Croatia's Zach Vukusic as the youngest captain in top-level men's Twenty20 cricket. Find out how a deck of playing cards can create a fun, challenging putting drill that improves every aspect of your game on the green. This simple twist will transform any ordinary practice session into a fun, competitive challenge that tests every aspect of your game on the green. To try it out, all you need is a standard deck of playing cards, a practice green with a few holes to putt to and a way to record your score. Start by splitting the cards into two decks: face cards (plus aces) and numbered cards. Next, shuffle both decks of cards. Each card will dictate three characteristics of your putt: distance, direction and slope.

Wondering what an NPU actually does and whether you even need it? We Quality Stock Arts/Shutterstock Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Bought a new laptop recently? Chances are that it's equipped with an NPU, a chip you're almost certainly not using. The NPU, or Neural Processing Unit, is a block of silicon that runs AI workloads at a fraction of the power a CPU or GPU needs. Roughly 2W compared to well over 100W that standard laptop discrete graphics need to do the same job. While they're not yet found in all laptops, they're now pretty much standard in mid-range and premium machines.

DePauw and Wabash met on a neutral field for the first time since 1922, and the Tigers won despite an injury to their starting quarterback. The 132nd edition of the Monon Bell Classic — the fierce Division III rivalry between DePauw and Wabash — was played at Ball State University's Scheumann Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 14. It was a game that came down to the final play, though, as Wabash reached the DePauw 15-yard line with nine seconds left. A pass toward the end zone on the next play was intercepted by the Tigers' Joey Fico, though, sealing the win for DePauw (9-1).

DaRon Bland clearly isn't working so in an effort to keep Caleb Downs at his best spot can't the Cowboys consider trying Bland at safety? The NFL's new player safety policy brings one-game suspensions for repeat violations, but no Buccaneers appear on the latest watch list. The NFL and NFL Players Association announced the changes on August 26, establishing a disciplinary system targeting five specific violations: hip-drop tackles, horse-collar tackles, launching, hits on defenseless players, and blindside blocks. Players who commit three violations of the same designated rule face a one-game suspension, making repeated dangerous techniques a potential personnel concern rather than simply a financial penalty.

Peoria Notre Dame sophomore Kamryn Gardiner secured a state title in the 100-yard butterfly at the IHSA finals. On what some might call a divinely orchestrated day, I had what remains my most surreal experience at an Arsenal game.I can remember it as clear as daylight. It was 14 March 2019, and Arsenal were due... I was standing with an old school and college friend among hundreds of fans in the concourse, waiting to go and sit down for the match. I couldn't help but look at the Arsenal hat-trick heroes board, which showed every single hat-trick my great-grandad, 1930s Gunners legend Ted Drake, scored. Something inside me told me to tell the slightly older guy with ginger hair and black glasses next to me who my great-grandfather was.

Is your gaming PC underperforming? You might have your monitor plugged into the wrong port. Despite handling the most flights in the world, the United States’ air traffic systems rely on 1980s-era computer equipment. It took Canada two years to replace paper flight strips with electronic ones in air traffic control towers, a simple transition to avoid cascading delays. Despite handling the most flights in the world, America’s air traffic control systems — still using 1980s-era equipment and prone to widespread failures — have lagged behind some global peers when it comes to improving technology.

The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos. Italian regulators have fined social media giant Meta €805m (£670m; $887m) for accessing Android users' photos without their specific consent. Stop mindlessly hitting putts. A simple deck of cards creates real pressure and exposes weak spots in your short game according to Golf.com. Chris George, a teacher featured by Golf.com , outlines a drill that uses a standard deck to dictate every shot. The setup is easy. Split the cards into two piles: face cards plus aces, and the numbered cards. Shuffle both. The card drawn sets the distance, the direction, and the slope. Numbered cards show the feet for the putt. Face cards have fixed lengths: Jacks are 15 feet, Queens are 20, Kings are 25, and Aces stretch to 35 feet.

Jenson Button argues that keeping Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll together is the key to Aston Martin's success, citing team atmosphere and driver feedback as critical factors. Alonso confirmed his return for the next season, a move that gave the entire project a significant boost. Button noted that drivers often jump between teams hoping to find a better fit, but that does not always work out. The environment matters more than the badge on the side of the car. When the team and drivers trust each other, the car performs better on the track.

After a slow start at The Spirit International Amateur Golf Championship, the University of Florida star saved his best for last, canning a 22-foot birdie putt at Whispering Pines Golf Club on the final hole for a one-stroke victory over Team Australia on Saturday. DAYTON, Ohio (AP) — Riley Allenspach scored 20 points and Cincinnati breezed to a 95-72 victory over Dayton on Saturday night.Allenspach made 9 of 13 shots with a 3-pointer, and his only free throw for the Bearcats (3-1), who picked up a win in their first road game this season. Tyler Tejeda totaled 16 points and nine rebounds for Cincinnati. Elijah Perryman and MJ Collins Jr. both scored 12. Mckenna Wucherer led the Gophers with 12 kills, with Zeynep Palabiyik tops with 13 digs and Stella Swenson pacing the team with 32 assists as 16 Minnesota players saw court time in the match. ... McKenna Johnson , a junior from Wilmot, went 7 of 13 from 3-point range on her way to a career-best 24 points for the Phoenix (2-2), which never trailed. Wisconsin (4-1), playing on the road for the first time this season, got 16 points from sophomore Iowa transfer Addie Deal , 15 from junior Teagan Mallegni and 12 from freshman Alicia Courthiau . (AP) — Trae’von Dunbar had 153 yards rushing and two touchdowns on 14 carries to help South Alabama beat Troy 27-14 on Saturday night to snap a three-game losing streak.Bishop Davenport had 122 yards passing and added a 28-yard rushing touchdown for South Alabama (5-5, 3-3 Sun Belt Conference). Dunbar ripped off a 46-yard touchdown run 1:23 into the game and scored a 44-yard rushing TD with 37 seconds left in the first quarter that made it 14-0. Goose Crowder was 24-of-41 passing for 231 yards with a 4-yard TD pass to Nick Hampton and added a 45-yard rushing TD for Troy (4-6, 2-4).

Boston returns home riding its longest winning streak of the season, but Dallas brings a familiar opponent and a chance to test just how much the Celtics have changed. The Celtics return to TD Garden on Sunday with momentum, a five-game winning streak and a fresh reminder of the franchise's recent championship history. Dallas visits Boston for the teams' first meeting since the 2024 NBA Finals, when the Celtics closed out the Mavericks in five games to capture the franchise's 18th championship. The rosters and circumstances have changed since then, but the matchup still gives Boston an intriguing measuring stick as it tries to keep its early-season surge going.

Christian Pulisic's brace in the USMNT's 6-0 win over Haiti was about more than goals: family, finding his joy again, and inspiring the next generation of American stars. MIAMI -- As his first of two goals hit the back of the net, Christian Pulisic, all smiles, ran towards the crowd, and he was greeted by warmth. His parents, his brother, his sister, his nieces - all had come to the game. Much of his family lives in Florida. They weren't going to miss it, nor were they going to miss the hugs that came after he scored.

After accounting for 13 points in Detroit's 19-9 win over Miami, Lions kicker Jake Bates has been named the Week 9 NFC Special Teams Player of the Week. How France beat South Africa 21-19, why Dupont and Lucu mattered, and what the Nations Championship win means for the 2027 Rugby World Cup. The Nations Championship win offered an encouraging look at what France can do when injuries disrupt its plans and an opponent threatens to take control. For the 2027 Rugby World Cup, that matters more than a sweeping declaration about favorites. France showed how it could win an uncomfortable match against the world champions, while also revealing weaknesses that still need attention.

Stranded during the nationwide FAA ground stop, Daniel Kaluuya and Tyriq Withers gave a viral interview at Oregon's Eugene Airport. Daniel Kaluuya and Tyriq Withers are managing to give the internet something else to talk about following the FAA’s nationwide ground stop . The two actors, who were among the passengers stranded Friday night as planes were grounded across the US, have since gone viral for a bizarre interview inside Eugene Airport in Oregon. Speaking with KVAL News as the airport descended into chaos, Kaluuya, 37, and Withers, 28, recounted how they were forced to deboard their Los Angeles-bound flight.

France beat South Africa 21-19 as Antoine Dupont helped deliver a tense Nations Championship victory at Stade de France. Antoine Dupont helped create France's decisive attacking moment, denied a potential Springbok try and secured possession during the closing sequence as the hosts survived without scoring after halftime. The victory was France's second in its last 11 meetings with South Africa and its first over the Springboks at Stade de France since 2005. It came despite a disrupted buildup and sustained pressure from the visitors' scrum.

The little-known defense giant does a lot of work for the Federal Aviation Administration and owns the equipment for the agency’s telecommunications network. The hourslong halt to departing flights across the country on Friday started with routine maintenance on air traffic control equipment at a remote site, federal officials said on Saturday. That work was being carried out by L3Harris Technologies, a little-known defense contractor that owns and operates essential communications infrastructure used by the Federal Aviation Administration.

Clemson freshman Tait Reynolds left Saturday's game with a knee injury after just two plays. The team now faces a critical uncertainty at the starting spot. He followed that big run with another carry where he kept the ball and picked up seven yards through the middle. Reggie Gilliam’s return could mean more than an extra body in Munich. The Patriots may finally have a chance to revive an under-center attack that has struggled to create explosive plays. The Patriots made a pair of roster moves before Sunday's game against Detroit that could shape more than their depth chart. New England activated fullback Reggie Gilliam and interior offensive lineman Greg Van Roten from injured reserve. The team also placed running back TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve, ending any chance of him playing against the Lions.

MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — Norman Powell scored 23 points, Matas Buzelis added 18 points and nine rebounds, and the short-handed Chicago Bulls won for the second night in a row with a 117-106 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves on Saturday.Buddy Hield and Tre Jones each chipped in 16 points off the bench for the Bulls, who ended Minnesota's five-game winning streak convincingly. Chicago's travel to Minneapolis on Friday was delayed by the nationwide ground stop that impacted many flights across the country. That meant the Bulls didn't arrive to Minnesota until the day of the game Saturday after beating the Hawks in Chicago on Friday.

After four years of state runs and close calls, it was finally Fossil Ridge's time. The SaberCats are your new Colorado 5A state volleyball champions. After nearly a half-decade of state-tournament appearances and semifinal spots (or better), a fifth set in the championship was no pressure at all. No. 5 Fossil Ridge outlasted No. 1 Legend in a five-frame thriller Nov. 14 at the Denver Coliseum for the program's first Colorado Class 5A volleyball title in a decade. Fossil took the first two sets, including a marathon 30-28 first and then consolidating it 25-18 in the second. The SaberCats were on the doorstep and then the tides turned just as quickly.

MLB proposes a 50/50 revenue split and salary cap to fix blackouts. The Braves and players must decide if this deal saves the game or limits spending. NASA's Voyager 1 is about to become humanity's first object to reach one light-day from Earth as it pushes ever deeper into interstellar space. That's a mind-blowing distance of more than 16 billion miles (26 billion kilometers) for the spacecraft launched 49 years ago. When Voyager 1 reaches that remarkable milestone on Wednesday, its radio signals will take precisely 24 hours traveling at the speed of light to reach Earth—in other words, one light-day. NASA is looking at another 18,000 years before the spacecraft achieves a full light-year and more than double that before it comes near another star.

Mechanic Carlos Perez felt fine as he finished up work at his car repair shop in June 2025. He sat down with a glass of water, planning to relax for a few minutes before heading home. Then, out of nowhere, his heart started pounding and his chest ached. When he tried to stand, "the world narrowed," Perez said. Perez called his daughter-in-law, a doctor, and she recommended he go to the emergency room. His wife brought him to the hospital. There, doctors determined that he was experiencing atrial fibrillation, or AFib , when the heart beats irregularly. The common condition can be dangerous: If left untreated, it can lead to stroke or heart failure.

The difference between PC GPUs and video game console GPUs is that consoles use a single, combined CPU and GPU unit whereas PCs keep them separate. Both have the same underlying tech, but console versions share more with the CPU. Luke James for Engadget Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Take the side panel off a gaming PC and the graphics card is the first thing you'll see. It's a slab the size of a hardback book slotted into the motherboard with fans bolted to it. But open up a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X and you'll see nothing of the kind. Instead, beneath the heatsink sits an AMD chip doing the work of both processor and graphics card.
